about_the_game:
In this captivating space adventure, you play as "Carter". A resourceful freelance space explorer tasked by the enigmatic Eagle-eye to conduct groundbreaking experiments on the Moon. But when your tests yield no new insights, things take a drastic turn: Eagle-eye remotely destroys your spaceship, leaving you stranded in the cold, unforgiving void of space.

With survival hanging by a thread, your only hope lies in an ingenious escape. A makeshift bridge crafted from random, orbiting debris around Earth, the only catch? Your former employer doesn't want you to return home, so you must conquer the puzzles and dodge the traps left by them.

With the help of your C.H.A.D or Cybernetic Humanoid Assistance Droid, you'll traverse a series of gravity-defying puzzles and obstacles as you navigate this precarious path home.

Using C.H.A.D's ability to slow down time, you can make landing on those pesky platforms a whole lot easier. 

Each step challenges your wit, agility, and determination, transforming a desperate situation into an epic quest for survival.

Will you muster the courage to climb down this celestial labyrinth and make it back to Earth? "The Long Fall Home" blends immersive storytelling, innovative puzzles, and a unique space setting into an unforgettable journey where every leap brings you closer to redemption.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, or 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (such as Intel HD 4000 or comparable) with DirectX 11 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel core i7 or AMD Ryzen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080 or RX 6700XT
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: THE LONG FALL HOME is a precision and puzzle platformer game. Featuring low gravity movement, cosmic abilities, a kooky sidekick and an unsettling atmosphere. Traverse down a bridge of space debris back to earth, while conquering the traps set and puzzles left by your former employer.
